summary: Frontend-only verification of 2 fixes on https://dhara-shield-2.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile viewport 375x667). BUG 1 (Help button overlapping Me tab) is CONFIRMED FIXED. BUG 2 (Evidence Locker PIN/camera/share feature) is COMPLETELY BROKEN on web — the screen crashes with a red-screen uncaught error on first mount and then gets permanently stuck on an infinite loading spinner, blocking all further testing of PIN create/confirm/unlock, photo/video capture, and share flows.

ui_bugs.issue: VERIFIED FIXED: no overlap found between floating Help button and the rightmost 'Me' tab on both Rights tab screen (Help btn y:442-487, Me tab y:607-659) and My Files tab screen (identical coords). Me tab was fully tappable on both screens and correctly navigated to /me.

CRITICAL RED SCREEN CRASH: Navigating to /women/evidence-locker while authenticated throws 'Uncaught Error: ExpoSecureStore.default.getValueWithKeyAsync is not a function' originating from evidenceLock.ts:14 (hasPin()) called from evidence-locker.tsx:26 useEffect. Root cause: expo-secure-store@15.0.8 has NO web implementation — node_modules/expo-secure-store/build/ExpoSecureStore.web.js literally exports `export default {}`, so every SecureStore method (getItemAsync/setItemAsync/deleteItemAsync) is undefined on web and throws when called directly (code does not guard with isAvailableAsync() or a Platform.OS==='web' check). After dismissing the red screen overlay, the PinGate component is permanently stuck in its 'checking' state (infinite ActivityIndicator) because the thrown promise rejection in hasPin() is never caught by PinGate's useEffect (`hasPin().then(...)` has no `.catch`), so setMode is never called and the whole screen is permanently unusable on web.

integration_issues.flow: Evidence Locker PIN create/confirm/unlock, Take photo, Record video, Share/Open, existing voice recording
integration_issues.issue: Could not verify ANY of these flows — the screen never renders past the PIN-gate 'checking' loading state on web due to the SecureStore crash above. This blocks 100% of BUG 2's requested verification scope in this environment.

react_native_issues.issue: hasPin()/setPin()/verifyPin() call expo-secure-store APIs unconditionally with no Platform.OS guard, fallback, or try/catch — crashes the entire screen on any platform/runtime where SecureStore has no native module backing (confirmed: web). Since this is the first gate on screen mount, it is a full feature outage, not a degraded experience.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix src/women/evidenceLock.ts to not crash on web — e.g. guard with `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { use AsyncStorage/localStorage fallback or SecureStore.isAvailableAsync() check }` before calling SecureStore.getItemAsync/setItemAsync/deleteItemAsync. Also add .catch() to the hasPin() promise chain in PinGate's useEffect so a failure surfaces an error state/message instead of an infinite spinner.

After the above fix, re-run full BUG 2 verification: PIN create -> confirm -> unlock -> re-navigate away and back (must re-prompt, not auto-unlock) -> Take photo button (permission prompt + camera open, note: real camera hardware not available in this automated browser, so only permission-prompt/no-crash can be verified even after the fix) -> Record video button (same caveat) -> Share/Open button (native share sheet, may be unavailable on web — verify it fails gracefully with the existing 'Sharing is not available on this device' status message instead of crashing) -> existing audio record/play/delete regression check.
No action needed for BUG 1 — confirmed resolved on both Rights and My Files tab-bar screens; Me tab fully tappable and navigates correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: evidenceLock.ts: all three exported functions (hasPin, setPin, verifyPin) have zero error handling around SecureStore calls; a single unguarded await makes the whole Evidence Locker screen uninstantiable wherever SecureStore is unavailable.

evidence-locker.tsx PinGate: `useEffect(() => { hasPin().then(exists => setMode(...)); }, [])` has no .catch — any rejection leaves `mode` stuck at 'checking' forever with no user-facing error or retry affordance.
GlobalHelpButton.tsx fix is clean and well-commented; the unified `insets.bottom + 180` offset works correctly across the two tab-bar screens tested.

rca_of_issue: Repro: login -> navigate to /women/evidence-locker directly (route reachable; also likely reachable via Women's Shield -> Evidence locker, not separately re-verified since the direct route already crashes identically) -> PinGate's useEffect fires hasPin() on mount -> hasPin() calls `await SecureStore.getItemAsync(PIN_HASH_KEY)` -> SecureStore.getItemAsync calls `ExpoSecureStore.getValueWithKeyAsync(...)` -> on web, expo-secure-store's native module binding (ExpoSecureStore.web.js) is `export default {}`, so `getValueWithKeyAsync` is undefined -> 'is not a function' TypeError -> uncaught, red screen. Dismissing the red screen reveals the screen is now permanently stuck on an ActivityIndicator because PinGate's mode state was never updated past 'checking' (no .catch on the promise). Mitigation: in evidenceLock.ts, branch on Platform.OS==='web' (or call SecureStore.isAvailableAsync() first) and use AsyncStorage as a non-secure web-only fallback for the PIN hash (acceptable since this is local-device-only threat model per the screen's own disclosure text), and add proper .catch()/error UI in PinGate.
